title: The Tense That Was Missing
label: ch:ar-the-tense-that-was-missing
canDo: I can put a verb in the present tense for myself with the أ- prefix, and I can say لا أفهم -- 'I do not understand' -- which is the sentence a beginner needs most and which this book was one form away from for six chapters.

payoff.summary: Eleven verbs taught as third-person past forms become first-person present forms, and each of them is then denied -- so a reading list turns into a speaking stock on one prefix.
payoff.note: لا أفهم needed no new vocabulary: لا came from chapter 5 and فهم from chapter 31, and only the tense was missing.
